notes.title: Better editing, and better support for Knuckles controller
notes.content:
Hi,

The latest update contains two important new features:
[list]
[*] When editing, you can now move and rotate already-placed blocks by dragging them---no need to first go to the "Selection" tool.  The Selection still exists but is now really only useful when you really want to select a number of blocks and move or remove them all together.

[*] The button mappings of the Knuckles controllers (from the Valve Index headset) is now a bit saner.  I played with the idea of displaying a glove instead of a controller, and reacting to hand gestures, but this is (IMHO) not as easy to use as the current way.  More about that later, possibly.
[/list]
Enjoy!
